purpose: Read-only independent eligibility audit; no model training or performance metrics.

method.gap_convention: calendar-month index difference: (2019*12+12)-(year*12+month); March 2018 to December 2019 = 21 months.
method.candidate_universe: Union of pre-target metadata dates and optical filenames across locked sites.
method.classification: confirmed requires nonempty readable files and metadata convention usable; any present-file versus metadata/bad/masked conflict is ambiguous; missing or unreadable required file is ineligible only when metadata also does not support usability. Raster plausibility is not interpreted as quality.
method.metadata_semantics_limit: Repository docs/code describe Boolean availability flags, bad indices as known-bad exclusions, and masked=true exclusion, but no authoritative upstream definition/reason was located for each flag. Conflicts are therefore left ambiguous.

fixed_site_intersection.definition: Sites confirmed eligible for every untrained candidate month (excluding the existing 2018-03 trained interval).
fixed_site_intersection.variable_site_comparison_warning: Per-gap comparisons with variable sites confound temporal gap with site composition.

recommendation: Resolve metadata conflicts with dataset-provenance/authoritative quality documentation before training. If unresolved, design a predeclared common-site subset or report variable-site composition and perform sensitivity analyses; do not call this inventory a trained temporal-gap result.

quality_flag_evidence.evidence: is_s1_usable/is_s2_usable require metadata Boolean true, no bad_data index, and masked=false; is_bld_usable requires buildings=true and masked=false.
preprocess_site reads fixed-date files directly and does not consult metadata.json or bad_data.json; optical is read without a quality mask; SAR pixel validity is based on NaN absence.
Sections 9-10 describe temporal availability and known-bad indices, but do not define why individual flags are false or establish an upstream reason for masked=true.
